description: Temporary use of part of Clapham Common for Oktoberfest on the Common 2026 event, involving installation and de-installation of temporary infrastructure including fencing, big top tent, lighting and other temporary structures, and other ancillary works (set up commencing 1st October with events from 9th October to 24th October with dismantling and off-site by 30th October).
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1. This permission is for a limited period of 30 days from 1st October expiring on 30th October and the works hereby permitted must be removed (and the land restored to its former condition) by or before 30th October 2026 in accordance with policies LP1, LP2 and LP14 of the Local Plan. 
Reason: The application for the erection of the event structures is for a limited period, the event structures are of a temporary nature and is unsuitable for retention on a permanent basis, to comply with Section 72 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed Site Location Plan; Proposed Site Plan Aerial V1.7, dated 11/11/2025; Proposed Site Plan V1.7, dated 11/11/2025; Ecology Management Plan; Sound Management Plan, prepared by Electric Star, dated 8/11/2025; Oktoberfest on the Common 2026: Statement on impact for biodiversity net gain; Construction Management Plan Version 1.0, dated 08/07/2026; Cycle Parking details; Event Operation and Access Statement V1.1, dated July 2026; Ground Management Plan V1.0, dated 07/07/2026; Heritage Statement V1.0, dated July 2026; Noise Management Plan V1.0, dated July 2026; Planning Statement V1.0, dated July 2026; OOTC26 - Site Safety Induction; OOTC26TMP V1.3 - Traffic Management Plan; OOTC26 - Vehicle movements accessing the site during the site set up and de-rig; OOTC26 - Lighting Plan V1, dated August 2026 and Waste Management Plan V1.0, dated 27/08/2026.
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 
Condition : 3 - 3. The noise level management measures and procedures contained within Sound Management Plan, prepared by Electric Star, dated 8/11/2025 in its entirety shall be implemented as part of the works pertaining to this temporary permission. 
Reason: To protect the amenities of neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policies LP2 and LP14 of the Local Plan.

Condition : 4 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
Condition : 5 - All reports and supporting information will be required to be updated and conducted within 2027 in the event a further application is made for temporoart permsion in the smae year.

open_spaces_details.description: Temporary fencing and structures for temporary change of use for event to take place

subdivision_of_building: This proposal covers no buildings as it is for temporary event and structures on open land.
